conflicts.permit: These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
conflicts.prohibit: RealDating will not sell or rent any client data loaded into our system and only the registered account holder and our support staff can gain access to the uploaded data.
conflicts.situation: A third-party service provider accessing uploaded user data/personal data to perform tasks on behalf of RealDating.
conflicts.reason: One statement strictly restricts access to only the account holder and support staff, while the other gives third-party service providers access without reconciling the restriction.
